notes: Supplied every joins the noun ish, no numeral or kol standing in the phrase to license it (rule 15).
The article on ha-makkah is unrepresented because the ASV renders the noun indefinitely, the a belonging to the noun (rules 15 and 29).
Both presentative there's stay with the morpheme that licenses them: haya under rule 21 and the finite verb yippol under rule 17.
